notes: Current knowledge-base documents take precedence over resolved cases.
Cases with status 'superseded' are historical and must not be presented as current guidance.

cases.title: Recurring export stopped after workspace timezone change
symptoms: Workspace timezone changed from Asia/Kolkata to Europe/London
Existing daily export did not run at the expected local time
Schedule displayed 'Timezone update pending'
resolution: Admin opened the existing recurring schedule
Admin reviewed the next-run time and saved the schedule
The pending-timezone notice disappeared
Admin used Run now to replace the previously missed delivery
cases.important_limit: Resaving changed future runs only; it did not automatically recreate the missed export.

cases.title: Viewer could not create an API credential
symptoms: User had the Viewer role
Developer settings were not visible
resolution: Confirmed that Viewers cannot create API credentials
An Admin created a narrowly scoped workspace credential for the approved integration
The secret was transferred through the customer's approved secret-management process
cases.important_limit: Support did not request or receive the credential secret.

cases.title: Export failed while a connection refresh was still running
symptoms: Run history showed source_refresh_timeout
Connection refresh completed 19 minutes after the export start time
resolution: Confirmed that exports wait up to 15 minutes for required refreshes
Admin adjusted the refresh schedule to complete before the export
Analyst used Run now after the next successful refresh

cases.title: Scheduled email export blocked for a new domain
symptoms: Run history showed destination_unverified
Recipients used a newly added external email domain
resolution: Owner resent the destination-verification link
Owner completed verification within 24 hours
Analyst used Run now and confirmed delivery acceptance

cases.title: Repeated render failures after documented checks
symptoms: Two consecutive runs showed render_failed
Dashboard opened successfully
Connections and destination were active
resolution: Collected workspace ID, dashboard ID, schedule ID, run IDs and timestamps
Escalated to the Rendering team without attaching exported customer data

cases.title: Analyst created a legacy personal API token
symptoms: Analyst needed API access for a personal script
resolution: Analyst opened Profile > Personal token
Analyst created a token linked to their user account
cases.superseded_reason: Legacy personal tokens were removed in OrbitDesk 4.0. Current workspace credentials must be created by an Owner or Admin.

cases.title: Connection request lacked enough diagnostic information
symptoms: User reported only that sync was broken
No connection name, state or error code was provided
resolution: Asked for workspace ID, connection ID, state, last successful refresh and latest error code
Did not request database passwords or OAuth tokens

cases.title: Audit timestamp appeared different from export schedule time
symptoms: Admin compared an audit event displayed in UTC with a schedule displayed in Asia/Kolkata
The two timestamps appeared to differ by five hours and thirty minutes
resolution: Converted both timestamps to UTC
Confirmed that the audit update and schedule save represented the same moment

cases.title: Suspected workspace API credential exposure
symptoms: Customer reported that a credential may have appeared in a CI log
The credential had export:read and connection:read scopes
resolution: Owner revoked the credential immediately and created a replacement with only the required scope
Admin reviewed credential audit events and affected integration activity
Support recorded credential ID, workspace ID and timestamps without requesting the secret value
cases.important_limit: Support treated the credential as exposed but did not ask the customer to paste it into the case.

cases.title: Connector internal error repeated after retry
symptoms: Two refresh attempts returned connector_internal_error
Connection configuration and upstream service health were unchanged
resolution: Collected workspace ID, connection ID, both refresh IDs, timestamps and the exact error code
Escalated to the Connectors team after the documented retry boundary was reached
Excluded database credentials and OAuth tokens from the escalation

cases.title: Requested export was outside delivery retention
symptoms: Customer requested the exact attachment from a run completed nine days earlier
Run history still showed a successful delivery
resolution: Explained that delivered export artifacts are retained for seven days
Analyst reran the export after confirming that current dashboard data was acceptable
Clarified that the rerun could contain newer data than the original attachment
cases.important_limit: The original expired attachment could not be restored or represented as identical by support.

cases.title: Audit event request exceeded retention window
symptoms: Admin searched for a workspace-role change from 104 days earlier
No matching event appeared in the audit log
resolution: Confirmed that workspace audit events are retained for 90 days
Explained that an absent expired event does not prove the action did not occur
Directed the customer to their external compliance archive for older records
cases.important_limit: OrbitDesk support could not reconstruct an audit event after retention expiry.
